notes: Purpur's own download URL always resolves to /v2/purpur/{version}/latest/download (no build-id path segment) -- the recorded server_build (2620) comes from a separate builds.latest metadata read. checksum.algorithm is md5 because that is the only hash Purpur's per-build API (/v2/purpur/{version}/{build}) actually publishes; verified against that, not sha256/sha1.
